rules: PRODUCTION_SPEC §12–§18; flat LIGHT backgrounds; PSREF images are on white — cut out (rembg) for coloured backgrounds. Whole real product; 1–3 words; 2-D objects next to the product; watermark below content; logo v5 end card; audio LOCKED (narrate.py + mix.sh). Length 45–55 s, HARD CAP 58 s (WORKFLOW). No Lenovo logo drawn; don't name a colour as 'US colour' (not confirmed).
official_clips: none — lenovo.com blocks automation; no promo video use
palette_for_this_video: paper #FAF8F5 main; sky for specs; lavender for the screen beat; blush #FBE7E2 THE CATCH; mint reveal; ember accent for prices/8 GB
new_objects: none expected — reuse clockRing, priceTag, globe, scale, oledStack/screenPath, battery, ramStick, sun, playIcon, dialScale, questionStamp, crossMark (render/kit/OBJECTS.md)

scenes.anchor: Lenovo's new laptop claims thirty hours of battery!
scenes.image: A (front, screen on, blue) cut out, centred 70% width
scenes.object: clockRing sweeps 0→30 h beside the laptop; small 'claimed' pill under it
scenes.note: frame 1 must read instantly: laptop + 30 HOURS

scenes.object: questionStamp slams onto the 30 h ring
globe mini spins, pin drops on USA

scenes.anchor: It just landed in the US, for eleven forty-nine.
scenes.object: priceTag '$1,149' swings in on the right, value rolls up

scenes.anchor: Here's the wild part. It weighs two point three pounds.
scenes.object: scale: laptop silhouette on one pan, weight text '2.3 lb' (1.06 kg small under); levels

scenes.anchor: You get a fourteen-inch OLED screen,
scenes.image: A crop on screen, slow push-in 85%
scenes.object: oledStack cross-section rises beside it (layers=1), label 14" 1920×1200

scenes.anchor: Here's the catch. The US model only comes with eight gigs of RAM.
scenes.object: ramStick n=1 drops in, label '8 GB' (ember); flag pill 'US'
second ramStick drops next to it labelled '16 GB' (muted) with globe mini; US stick stays at 1

scenes.anchor: And those thirty hours? That's video playback, at low brightness.
scenes.object: playIcon on the screen + sun with short rays '150 nits'; clockRing 30 h gets a fine-print pill: 'MobileMark 30 @250 nits: 18.4 h'

scenes.anchor: By our score? Fifty-one out of a hundred.
scenes.object: dialScale needle sweeps to 51 (cut-off mark at 55)

scenes.anchor: Wreck, unless battery is all you need.
scenes.object: k falls (WRECK end-card motion); small pill '✓ battery' fades in

scenes.anchor: Be honest. Would you pay eleven fifty for eight gigs?
scenes.object: priceTag '$1,149' + ramStick '8 GB' side by side; questionStamp '?'
